ideas.summary: Believers should not fear death since there is no set time and going to heaven should bring joy, not fear.
ideas.note: p2 states no fear, no fixed hour, heaven should be joy.

ideas.summary: Living is abused when death is feared; fear of death is the devil's old strategy.
ideas.note: p3 states abuse to the person and the devil's unchanged old strategy. Residual QUESTIONABLE causal clause does not omit the IDEA.

ideas.summary: Death as gain must become one's lived reality, not merely an intellectual idea.
ideas.note: p4: not mind over matter; must be your reality, not a sermon idea.

ideas.summary: Fear of death observed even among believers reveals it is not yet fully embraced as gain.
ideas.note: Automated first-pass marked WEAKLY_REPRESENTED on lexical overlap 0.0392. Human reading: p5 is a near-direct written form of SRC007115-118. Override to CLEARLY_REPRESENTED.

ideas.summary: If a believer does not practice Christ as life, facing death becomes heavy and difficult.
ideas.note: p6: practice Christ / death difficult / death heavy.

ideas.summary: Some believers foreknow the exact hour of their death and depart peacefully.
ideas.note: p7: two men, exact hour and date, I'll go to heaven.
